title: introduce-prompt-mutation-prober-and-prioritized-fix-suggester
author: Maya Kline
description: Motivation: subtle prompt-edit regressions are hard to catch with static anchor tests; small mutations in phrasing can cause quality regressions in a narrow set of examples. This PR adds a lightweight prompt-mutation prober that synthesizes controlled perturbations of prompt templates and integrates with the CI gating pipeline to provide a prioritized list of candidate fixes when regressions are detected. Design summary: 1) mutation_prober.py implements deterministic mutation operators (synonym substitution, punctuation jitter, role-label swap, controlled shortening/expansion) applied to prompt templates and example inputs; 2) a statistical scorer computes delta distributions across existing metrics (exact-match, BLEU-like similarity, intent-classifier drift) and surfaces tests that regress beyond per-cohort adaptive thresholds; 3) prioritized-fix-suggester takes failing probes and proposes minimal prompt edits (reordering, explicit constraints, anchor hints) ranked by expected quality lift and risk; 4) a new CI hook (ci/hooks/prompt_mutation_gate.py) runs a limited probe sample during PRs and annotates failures with actionable suggestions in the PR thread. Checklist: - [x] mutation operators implemented and unit-tested - [x] lightweight sampling scheduler to bound CI cost - [x] integration with existing cohort scoring and thresholding - [x] PR annotation / tip generation - [x] docs and runbook for on-call. Related work: builds on ENG-2145 (cohort sensitivity prioritizer) and uses eval-harness scoring primitives from ENG-2199. Usage: by default the hook runs in dry-run mode on forks and non-critical branches; on protected branches it can block merges if the mutation probe finds high-confidence regressions (configurable by label). Links: linear/ENG-2145, docs/internal/mutation-prober-runbook.md

review_comments: Jordan Li: Nice job keeping the mutators deterministic by seed. A couple of nits: please separate the synonym dictionary so it can be swapped per-locale.
Maya Kline: Good point, moved synonyms into eval/probers/lexica/* and added locale switch in the sampling scheduler.
Hannah Ortiz: The CI cost limiter looks sensible but we should fail closed only for 'protected' changes; please add config and mention it in the runbook.
Maya Kline: Added 'protected_branch_threshold' configuration and documented behavior in the runbook. Also added a dry-run override for forks.
Ravi Menon: Can the priority suggester surface confidence estimates and an undo patch? Would help automated rollback during canaries.
Maya Kline: Added confidence score and a minimal patch generator (text diff) to the suggester output; included tests.
merge_result: merged (squash) by release-bot on 2025-10-22; merge commit: squash of 5 commits; backcompat note: default behavior is opt-in for blocking on protected branches
release_notes: Introduce a prompt mutation prober and CI hook that detects small phrasing regressions and suggests prioritized minimal prompt fixes. Default runs in dry-run; blocking behavior configurable per-branch.
tests_and_qa: Unit tests added for operators and suggester (tests/test_mutation_prober.py). Ran an internal smoke run against 3 prompt cohorts, compared against baseline evaluator; false-positive rate estimated ~2.3% at current thresholds. QA: Eng + SRE ran a staged rollout on the canary pipeline before enabling on main.
notes_for_oncall: If the probe starts failing en masse after config changes, check synonym lexica and scheduler seed changes; to mute noisy alerts, set 'mutation_probe.sample_rate' to 0.1 and open ENG ticket for threshold tuning.
